title: The judge, the judgment and the threat
description: Justice Gautam Patel’s unabashed manner of chiding lawyers in his peculiar style of speaking, coupled with judgments written in crisp, short sentences, revealed a man who loved the law and, more importantly, his job.Lawyers who found themselves on the receiving end of his sharp remarks on a particular day would, at best, discuss and criticise his behaviour over routine evening tea with their sympathisers.
